description:
About the job

Description

We are looking for a Sr. Social and Creators Product Manager for the Amazon Mexico business to drive growth for the Amazon Mexico Stores via automated (performance) marketing channels.

We are looking for a marketing leader who likes to use technology to improve the customer experience and make a meaningful difference to how our customers shop online. At Amazon, we aim to become Earth’s most Customer-Centric Company and continue to innovate the way we engage with our customers through various marketing programs.

Critical missions of Paid Social and Creators team in Mexico are 1) to drive traffic and create innovative marketing programs in existing channels to make Amazon the most preferred shopping and entertainment destination for customers in Mexico, 2) to provide the best-in-class customer experience with highly personalized engaging marketing programs to help our customers make purchasing decisions, 3) to educate and attract new customers to Amazon overall and specific offerings, and 4) to dive deep into data to gain insights and optimize marketing programs.

The Sr. Social and Creators Product Manager plays a critical role in realizing these missions, leading various online marketing functions for Amazon.com.mx, managing and improving the marketing programs in Social Media Advertising and Creators Marketing. They will also be responsible for driving innovation by owning internally developed automated marketing products and platforms by leveraging the Amazon’s technologies. This position is one of the key senior roles in the Mexico Marketing and Prime organization. The impact of this role is significant, accounting for a large percentage of all amazon.com.mx new customers, traffic and sales. The position reports to the Head of Automated Marketing for Amazon Mexico.

Key job responsibilities


 Lead formulation of Social and Creators strategies for Mexico, including identifying key target customer segments, competitive environment, our program’s strengths and areas to invest for future innovations
 Manage, improve and innovate marketing programs, such as Automated Invoicing solutions, Social Ads, creators products.
 Drive topline while managing marketing budget, meeting ROI criteria.
 Deliver results and help Amazon meet or exceed goals in sales, profitability, new customers, and various high-value Amazon programs such as Prime membership.
 Work directly with tech teams across Amazon to define and get new development projects on tech roadmap
 Develop strong relationships and work collaboratively with the category leadership to achieve shared goals.
 Work closely with central Automated Marketing stakeholders and technical resources to ensure the company’s infrastructure, architecture, and site features support and enhance the effectiveness of Automated Marketing team’s programs.
 Identify the unique opportunities and challenges in Mexico by leveraging learnings from customer insights
 Share and learn worldwide best practices to mutually help worldwide marketing teams achieve goals.


About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 7+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
 Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
 Experience with end to end product delivery
 Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
 Experience as a product manager or owner
 Experience owning technology products
 Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
 Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
 Experience in delivering end-to-end customer research studies, including study design, fieldwork (qualitative research moderation and survey execution), analysis, recommendations, reporting and presentation of results to senior leadership

title: Creator Manager - TikTok Shop
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
Team Intro
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a passionate and strategic Creator Manager to join our team. You will be responsible for discovering, incubating, and educating e-commerce creators, with a focus on helping vertical creators improve their sales performance. You will collaborate closely with industry teams to match high-potential creators with quality content formats, including short videos and live streaming. Additionally, you will support major campaigns, marketing initiatives, and creator education efforts by providing relevant content and guidance. A key part of your role will be working with the content moderation team to educate creators on platform policies and ensure compliance. 

Responsibilities: 
- Identify, onboard, and incubate e-commerce creators within specific verticals to drive sales growth. 
- Develop and implement strategies to scale creator success, leveraging data insights to guide decision-making. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Category, Marketing, Campaign operations) to match creators with suitable content opportunities and promotional activities. 
- Provide ongoing education and support to creators, helping them optimize content strategy, understand platform rules, and improve performance. 
- Work with the content moderation team to ensure creators adhere to platform guidelines and policies.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable plans. 
- Service-oriented mindset, patience, and excellent communication skills to support and educate creators. 
- Fast learner who can quickly absorb information and effectively teach others. 
- Team player with a strong sense of responsibility and a positive, can-do attitude. 
- Proficient in data analysis and comfortable using metrics to drive decisions. 
 
Preferred Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in operations or partner management
- Able to establish contact, build up trust with creators, and provide complete support on platform training, creator engagement activities.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

description:
About the job

About the Team

The DoorDash Campaign Operations team's mission is to efficiently deliver high quality, relevant CRM communications that meet the needs of our audiences, globally. To accomplish this mission, we're building a team of technical CRM and lifecycle marketing experts who build, QA, and launch email, push, SMS, and in-app campaigns designed by our Lifecycle Marketing partners. This team is goaled on high-quality campaign delivery and operational efficiency so that each campaign reaches the correct audience on-time with excellent craft.

About the Role

As the Senior Associate, Campaign Operations, you will be responsible for building, testing, and launching CRM and Lifecycle Marketing campaigns designed by our Lifecycle Marketing partners. This is a hands-on CRM execution and QA role — not a brand, content, social media, performance-marketing, or campaign-strategy position. You will partner closely with the Lifecycle Marketing team and Project Managers to ensure each campaign has completed all required steps prior to launch, and is delivered on time to the end-consumer, with high quality and excellent craft. You will be responsible for the high quality campaign delivery rate and production efficiency of each campaign launch. This role will report to the Campaign Ops Manager who sits in Mexico City.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Campaign QA & Execution: Build, test, and launch CRM and lifecycle marketing campaigns across email, push notifications, SMS, in-app messaging, and other channels using Braze and in-house tools. Own the end-to-end QA review process, build target audience segments and personalization logic, and collaborate with designers and copywriters to execute against the campaign brief.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with teams such as Lifecycle Marketing, Martech, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Design to align on CRM campaign goals, audience segmentation, and creative execution.

Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary point of contact for Campaign Operations for your Lifecycle Marketing partners, ensuring alignment with company goals and priorities.
Tool Expertise: Leverage Braze and other internal CRM/marketing automation platforms to implement sophisticated lifecycle campaigns, including automation, dynamic content, and A/B testing.


We're excited about you because you bring…

Majority of your day-to-day responsibilities (75%+) involved hands-on campaign execution — directly building, configuring, QAing, and launching lifecycle campaigns rather than primarily developing strategy or coordinating execution through other teams.

Familiarity with additional marketing automation/CRM tools is a plus.
You should be comfortable personally configuring audiences/segments, entry and exit criteria, triggers, decision splits, suppressions, personalization/dynamic content, testing, scheduling, and campaign deployment.
Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Analytical Mindset: Ability to interpret data and analytics to inform decisions and optimize campaign development and quality. 
Collaborative Approach: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

About the job

We're a fast-growing performance marketing agency that manages tens of millions per month in direct-response ad spending for awesome direct-to-consumer brands.




We work with disruptive brands, big budgets, and make crazy ideas come to life!




Our model is built upon the core values of Alignment and Transparency, which means that, unlike traditional agencies that win by charging huge retainers, Pilothouse wins by delivering huge results.




Alongside our team of 180+ members spanning Media Buyers, Copywriters, Content Managers, Landing Page Developers, Content Creators, Email & SMS Coordinators, CGC & Influencer Managers, we need an Amazon Growth Specialist to own the day-to-day growth and performance of Amazon accounts and work alongside an amazing team.

Experience working directly with clients, including leading calls and presenting performance and strategy




ESSENTIAL QUALITIES:

Strategic thinker who can connect day-to-day Amazon execution to broader business and growth goals
Highly analytical and comfortable using data to identify opportunities, diagnose performance issues, and make decisions
Strong communicator who can turn complex Amazon data into clear recommendations for clients and teammates
Highly organized and able to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines independently
Proactive and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and a constant drive to improve how things are done




THE DAY-TO-DAY:

Own the advertising strategy and ongoing optimization for a portfolio of Amazon accounts, including campaign structure, bids, budgets, targeting, search terms, and negatives
Analyze account performance and identify opportunities across advertising, organic growth, conversion, catalogue health, and competitive positioning
Develop and maintain account strategies, including traffic and conversion plans based on client goals, search data, and competitive insights
Identify listing and catalogue optimization opportunities and work with our support team to execute and quality-check improvements
Plan and coordinate promotions, major retail events, and inventory needs to support sustained account growth
Lead recurring client calls, reporting, and strategic discussions while keeping clients aligned on goals, performance, and next steps

ABOUT THE POSITION

This is a hands-on Amazon growth role for someone who understands that successful Amazon management goes well beyond adjusting bids.

You'll be responsible for looking at the full picture — advertising performance, search behavior, catalogue health, conversion, inventory, promotions, and competitive positioning — and turning those insights into clear actions that drive growth for our clients.

You'll work closely with the Head of Amazon and a broader team of channel specialists and support partners. We’re looking for someone who can operate independently, communicate confidently with clients, and isn't afraid to get into the details when an account needs attention.

We're also building and refining how we approach Amazon at Pilothouse, so we're looking for someone who enjoys improving processes, documenting what works, experimenting with new tools, and sharing their knowledge with the team.

Whether you're deep in an Amazon Ads report, preparing for Prime Day, reviewing a listing optimization, or presenting your latest growth opportunities to a client, you'll have a direct impact on the performance of the accounts you manage.




ABOUT PILOTHOUSE

We are focused on building a team of hustlers who are passionate about the Direct-To-Consumer space and who are eager to learn and grow. We push each other to do awesome work and encourage team members to bring even the wildest ideas forward.

Team culture is everything at Pilothouse. We have regular check-ins to discuss industry trends and new opportunities. You'll work with a team that has decades of marketing experience who want to learn from you just as much as you will from them.

Experience managing multiple brands or categories in an agency environment

title: Growth Marketing Engineer
skills: Paid acquisition: Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns (Google Ads — Performance Max and Search, LinkedIn), architecting campaign structure, audience targeting, and conversion-event mapping so spend optimizes toward booked demos and pipeline rather than clicks, with clean, server-imported conversion tracking (enhanced/offline conversions from the CRM).

CRO instincts and conversion copywriting ability.

A reliable weekly reporting cadence that ties marketing activity to pipeline.
Experience in HR tech, workforce, background screening, or compliance-adjacent categories.
Account-based marketing (ABM) and audience segmentation.
Server-side, enhanced, or offline conversion tracking (e.g. CAPI).

About the job

About Turn

Turn is a venture-backed B2B software company built for the realities of high-volume hiring. Our platform runs pre-employment background checks and continuous monitoring, and integrates directly into the systems employers already hire with — so teams in hospitality, staffing, construction, healthcare, and real estate can screen candidates fast without giving up compliance. We’re a small, fully remote team that moves quickly and ships real things.




About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Engineer to own our full-funnel demand engine and turn the traffic and buying signals we already generate into qualified demos and pipeline.

You’ll sit at the intersection of performance marketing, marketing operations, conversion optimization, and analytics, building and running the systems that move a prospect from first touch to booked meeting. This is a builder’s role: you’ll spend your days in the ad platforms, the CRM, the analytics tools, and the page builder, shipping changes and measuring their impact on qualified-demo volume and pipeline.




What You’ll Do
Paid acquisition: Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns (Google Ads — Performance Max and Search, LinkedIn), architecting campaign structure, audience targeting, and conversion-event mapping so spend optimizes toward booked demos and pipeline rather than clicks, with clean, server-imported conversion tracking (enhanced/offline conversions from the CRM).
Conversion rate optimization: Build and A/B test dedicated demo landing pages, landing pages, forms, and CTAs that turn visitors into meetings, including persona-aware routing (buyer vs. candidate vs. partner) across the site, and own the on-site demo path.
Marketing operations & RevOps: Own the full lead lifecycle and the automation behind it — CRM workflows, lifecycle-stage instrumentation, lead scoring and routing, and the visitor-signal-to-outbound engine across HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Duo, and Zapier. Build and scale the loop that turns identified in-market website visitors into timely, signal-based 1:1 outreach.
Email deliverability & infrastructure: Own outbound sending infrastructure — mailbox and domain strategy, warm-up and rotation, pre-send verification, and deliverability health — so outreach lands in the inbox and protects the primary domain’s reputation.
Analytics & reporting: Build and own the measurement layer end to end — define the key conversion events, GA4, UTM governance, conversion validation — and build the dashboards that tie marketing activity to pipeline and revenue (Mode).
Conversion copywriting: Write the ad, landing-page, and signal-based outbound copy that drives response.




What You’ll Need
Hands-on experience across growth marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, or revenue operations — ideally in B2B SaaS. You’re a builder who works inside the tools, not only a strategist.
Real performance-marketing experience, especially Google Ads (including Performance Max and Search campaign structure), with a habit of optimizing toward CAC and pipeline instead of vanity metrics.
Fluency with a modern marketing / CRM automation stack (we use HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Intercom, Zapier, and Calendly; comparable tools like Salesforce, Marketo, or Make are fine).
Analytics chops: GA4, disciplined UTM and conversion tracking, and enough SQL / BI to build your own dashboards (we use Mode; Looker, Amplitude, or similar is fine).
CRO instincts and conversion copywriting ability.
A data-driven, experimental, self-directed way of working — you read the funnel, ship the fix, and measure the result.
Bilingual Spanish/English, with fluent written English.




This is our ideal profile, not a checklist. If you can do the work, we’d love to hear from you regardless of years or title.




Success Metrics (First 6–12 Months)
Growth in qualified demos and marketing-sourced pipeline, at flat or lower cost per acquisition.
Higher conversion rates across the funnel, from visitor to demo to booked meeting.
A larger share of best-fit (ICP) traffic reached and converted.

description:
About the job

Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

The Global Performance Marketing Manager - B2B will be responsible for paid advertising channels (Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant upcoming channels) that drive our B2B growth in our mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. You will strengthen our paid marketing team with your deep expertise in paid ads channels and your ability to think analytically and creatively.

This is a hands-on role that combines strategic thinking with day-to-day campaign ownership. You will oversee a multi-million euro annual paid media budget across multiple markets, products and customer segments, while collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders. Success in this role will be driven primarily by your ability to develop strategy, work full-funnel, solve complex performance challenges, and execute at a high level.

How will you make an impact?


Be the global subject matter expert and owner for paid advertising in lead generation at Docplanner, especially in Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn Ads
Make sure we are generating the highest possible volume of leads from paid marketing channels while ensuring lead quality and staying within budget and CPA goals
Provide data-driven guidance to content and design teams on creative concepts, messaging, formats, and offers
Set up structured creative tests and turn insights into scalable best practices
Proactively identify creative opportunities and drive a strong pipeline of new assets across markets
Manage and develop paid marketing specialists across different markets, providing guidance, feedback, and support in their daily work
Identify and implement AI-powered workflows to reduce manual, repetitive tasks and enable teams to operate more efficiently at scale
Serve as strategic advisor and mentor for your direct reports and other team members on matters related to paid ads
Forecast, set, and monitor pacing for the channel budgets in consultation with local marketers to ensure all stakeholders have an overview of spending
Develop new hypotheses for how to improve paid advertising approach and work with paid marketing specialists across local teams to implement tests based on them
Together with stakeholders from marketing operations, lead generation, and marketing analytics, regularly analyse performance of paid marketing campaigns and recommend improvements to campaigns based on insights generated
Support junior paid marketing specialists in their skill and knowledge development while not being afraid to “get your hands dirty” with day-to-day work
Proactively bring solutions to improve processes and workflows as budgets and the organisation grow


Qualifications


Deep paid marketing experience with 6-8+ years managing paid ads campaigns hands-on, ideally in international high-growth or performance agency environments
An opinion and point of view when it comes to topics like: hooks, ad formats, and making the connection between ads that attract attention and ads that convert
A proven track record in managing and executing paid marketing strategies that have a direct impact on company revenue
Strong analytical and reporting skills to connect campaign, funnel, and business metrics in order to identify opportunities and root causes of underperformance
Experience using AI to analyze performance trends, generate testing hypotheses, and uncover growth opportunities
Ability to give feedback, structure priorities, and help others grow
Familiarity with modern targeting strategies and automation in the ad platforms - while still using tried and true techniques for ad optimization
A strategic thinker who enjoys hands-on execution
Strong project management skills with ability to work cross functionally, manage, implement and analyse various initiatives in a fast-paced environment
Strong level of business English and secondary language amongst the following would be a plus: Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, Polish


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

skills: Build AI-native self-service using Amazon Connect AI agents, Amazon Q in Connect, and Amazon Bedrock (Claude model family), implementing multi-agent orchestration patterns, orchestrator agents delegating to task-specific agents with escalation paths to human queues

Engineer prompts and tool-calling integrations at production scale: SearchProfiles lookups, case creation, external API tools, authentication flows, and guardrails against hallucination and verification loops
Implement barge-in handling, fallback, and error-recovery behavior for voice AI, and validate it with turn-by-turn trace analysis
Optimize inference cost and latency hands-on: model tier selection (Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus), prompt caching, and token budgeting against containment- rate targets

Diagnose AI agent performance using observability tooling (agent spans, and CloudWatch) that correlates contact flow logs, conversation transcripts, AI agent spans, tool executions, and token usage to isolate latency, cost, and quality issues
Build conversational experiences where intent-based NLU is the right fit, including multilingual support and SSML-tuned voice interactions
Build contact flows that integrate AI agents, Lambda-backed business logic, Customer Profiles, and dynamic data-driven routing

Implement Amazon Connect Cases and Tasks solutions: case templates, queue-based work allocation, SLA/TAT monitoring, approval workflows, and migrations from legacy case systems (e.g., consolidating hundreds of service categories and thousands of business rules into a unified Cases model)
Configure and operationalize Contact Lens for real-time sentiment, post-contact summaries, category rules, and quality management

Implement proficiency-based and attribute-driven routing, outbound campaigns (including answering machine detection and compliance controls), and workforce management (WFM) integrations for forecasting, scheduling, and adherence (FCS)
Build out the Amazon Connect analytics data lake (Glue, Lake Formation, Athena) and QuickSight dashboards for real-time operations and executive reporting
Support legacy platform migrations (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, Salesforce): flow conversion, data migration, parallel-run validation, and production cutover on live contact centers
Build custom Agent Workspace experiences with the Amazon Connect Streams API, third-party app embedding, and CRM screen-pop integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, custom systems)
Build serverless, event-driven backends with Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, and Kinesis for real-time event processing and customer journey orchestration

Treat accessibility as a first-class requirement: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant components, automated axe-core/Playwright accessibility scanning, and support for VPAT/Section 508 documentation on government and enterprise engagements
Author infrastructure as code with AWS CDK (TypeScript) as the primary tool and CloudFormation or Terraform where customer environments require them
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and automated test suites: Jest/Vitest unit tests, Playwright E2E and API tests, and integration tests against live Connect instances
Follow phased rollout patterns for production contact centers where downtime is measured in missed calls; write the runbooks that make cutovers boring
Instrument monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and custom dashboards across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents) and participate in production incident triage

About the job

Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

As a Senior CXE Engineer, you are a hands-on builder on enterprise contact center transformations. You will spend the majority of your time in code and in the AWS console: building contact flows and AI agents, writing Lambda functions and CDK stacks, developing React-based agent and admin tooling, and debugging production issues on systems that serve tens of thousands of agents and millions of customer interactions. You work within architectures set by practice leads, and you’re expected to pressure-test them, propose better patterns, and own the implementation quality of your workstream from first commit through production cutover. This role blends deep Amazon Connect platform engineering, generative AI development on Bedrock and Claude, and full-stack serverless work, with regular direct interaction with customer engineering teams.

Your Assignment

AI Agent & Conversational AI Development


Build AI-native self-service using Amazon Connect AI agents, Amazon Q in Connect, and Amazon Bedrock (Claude model family), implementing multi-agent orchestration patterns, orchestrator agents delegating to task-specific agents with escalation paths to human queues
Engineer prompts and tool-calling integrations at production scale: SearchProfiles lookups, case creation, external API tools, authentication flows, and guardrails against hallucination and verification loops
Implement barge-in handling, fallback, and error-recovery behavior for voice AI, and validate it with turn-by-turn trace analysis
Optimize inference cost and latency hands-on: model tier selection (Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus), prompt caching, and token budgeting against containment- rate targets
Diagnose AI agent performance using observability tooling (agent spans, and CloudWatch) that correlates contact flow logs, conversation transcripts, AI agent spans, tool executions, and token usage to isolate latency, cost, and quality issues
Build conversational experiences where intent-based NLU is the right fit, including multilingual support and SSML-tuned voice interactions


Amazon Connect Platform Engineering


Build contact flows that integrate AI agents, Lambda-backed business logic, Customer Profiles, and dynamic data-driven routing
Implement Amazon Connect Cases and Tasks solutions: case templates, queue-based work allocation, SLA/TAT monitoring, approval workflows, and migrations from legacy case systems (e.g., consolidating hundreds of service categories and thousands of business rules into a unified Cases model)
Configure and operationalize Contact Lens for real-time sentiment, post-contact summaries, category rules, and quality management
Implement proficiency-based and attribute-driven routing, outbound campaigns (including answering machine detection and compliance controls), and workforce management (WFM) integrations for forecasting, scheduling, and adherence (FCS)
Build out the Amazon Connect analytics data lake (Glue, Lake Formation, Athena) and QuickSight dashboards for real-time operations and executive reporting
Support legacy platform migrations (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, Salesforce): flow conversion, data migration, parallel-run validation, and production cutover on live contact centers


Full-Stack & Portal Engineering


Build custom Agent Workspace experiences with the Amazon Connect Streams API, third-party app embedding, and CRM screen-pop integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, custom systems)
Build serverless, event-driven backends with Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, and Kinesis for real-time event processing and customer journey orchestration
Treat accessibility as a first-class requirement: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant components, automated axe-core/Playwright accessibility scanning, and support for VPAT/Section 508 documentation on government and enterprise engagements


Infrastructure, Delivery & Quality


Author infrastructure as code with AWS CDK (TypeScript) as the primary tool and CloudFormation or Terraform where customer environments require them
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and automated test suites: Jest/Vitest unit tests, Playwright E2E and API tests, and integration tests against live Connect instances
Follow phased rollout patterns for production contact centers where downtime is measured in missed calls; write the runbooks that make cutovers boring 
Instrument monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and custom dashboards across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents) and participate in production incident triage
Apply security and compliance baselines in everything you ship: least-privilege IAM, DevSecOps scanning, encryption standards

description:
About the job

About Finances Demystified

Finances Demystified runs Women in Wealth, a year-long financial education program for members in the United States. Members learn options strategies, long-term investing, financial health, legacy planning, and the mindset work that holds it all together. Our members are mostly women building wealth for the first time in their families.




About the role

Client Success Managers keep members moving through the program. After our onboarding team welcomes a new member, you connect with her early in her first month and stay with her through the year. You are not doing it alone. You work alongside our customer support, tech support, and education teams.




Your job is to make sure nobody gets lost. You keep track of who is active, who has gone inactive, and who has stopped responding, and you reach out before a quiet stretch turns into someone giving up. When a member is discouraged or behind, you are the one who gets her moving again. When a question falls outside your lane, you route it to the right person on the team.

This is a full-time role, and most of your day is spent on member calls over Google Meet.

This is not a financial advice role. You will not analyze trades or tell anyone what to do with their money. But the people who do this job best genuinely love the subject.




What you will do

Run your first call with each new member and set expectations for the year
Hold regular check-in calls with your members
Track who is active, inactive, or unresponsive
Reach out early when a member goes quiet
Keep members connected to the community and live sessions
Route financial, technical, and billing questions to the right team




What this role is not

We want to be direct about this, because it matters.

You will not give trading advice or recommend stocks, funds, or investments
You will not answer technical investing questions
You will not give tax, legal, or personalized financial advice
You will not coach one on one outside scheduled calls
You will not act as a therapist or counselor. You refer members to appropriate support instead




What we are looking for

Warmth that holds a line. You can be encouraging and still tell someone they are behind and need to catch up. Those are not opposites, and the role needs both.

Organization across a caseload. You have kept track of a large group of people before and you can describe how you did it.

Noticing before reacting. The value of this role is catching a problem before anyone raises it. If you have done that, we want to hear about it.

Clean handoffs. When something falls outside your scope, you pass it on quickly and clearly rather than trying to solve it yourself.

Fluency without the urge to advise. You do not need a finance career, but you should be fascinated by money. You read about it, you take care of your own finances, and you enjoy learning how investing works. That helps you connect with members and route their questions to the right person faster.

Comfort on camera. Member calls happen in English on Google Meet, often with people who are frustrated, behind, or ready to quit.

A real connection with who our members are. You understand what it means to build wealth without a family blueprint for it.




Requirements

Deep familiarity with American culture and experience working with US clients
Fluent spoken English
Fully remote. Where you live today does not matter
Reliable internet and a quiet space for calls
Available during US business hours for member calls
Experience in client success, account management, coaching, community, or a similar relationship-driven role
Preferred: a background in finance or a strong personal interest in it. That could be work in financial services, financial education, banking, accounting, or insurance, or your own investing. No credentials required




Compensation

$36,000 to $48,000 USD per year ($3,000 to $4,000 per month), depending on experience. Full-time, independent contractor.




How to apply

Apply here on LinkedIn. Shortlisted applicants will receive a short written application, in English, as the next step.

Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Clear communication with customer-facing composure, able to demo your work, explain trade-offs, and run working sessions with client engineers
AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML/Connect-relevant Specialty)
Contact center migration experience (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, or Salesforce to Amazon Connect)

title: Engineer - Data Analyst
skills: Build Dashboards & Reports: Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Tableau and/or Power BI that deliver actionable insights to business stakeholders. Own the full lifecycle from requirements gathering to published, production-grade visualizations.

Data Analysis & Storytelling: Analyze manufacturing, operational, and financial data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities. Translate findings into clear, compelling visual narratives that drive decision-making across teams.
SQL & Data Exploration: Write SQL queries in Snowflake to extract, transform, and validate data for reporting. Perform ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions and support strategic initiatives.

Support Data Modeling: Collaborate with data engineers to define reporting requirements and contribute to dbt model development — building or modifying staging and mart models that feed dashboards and reports.
Analytical Mindset: Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot data inconsistencies, ask the right questions, and deliver accurate, trustworthy reporting.
Documentation & Training: Document data definitions, metric calculations, and dashboard usage guides. Provide training and support to business users to promote self-service analytics adoption.
Experience: 2+ years of experience in a data analyst, BI analyst, or reporting analyst role with a portfolio of dashboards and reports delivered to business stakeholders.

Technical Prowess: o Strong proficiency in Tableau and/or Power BI: calculated fields, LOD expressions (Tableau), DAX measures (Power BI), parameters, dynamic filters, row-level security, and performance optimization.
Working knowledge of SQL for querying Snowflake: JOINs, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and basic data transformation.
Foundational understanding of dbt: ability to read and modify existing models, understand the staging/mart layer structure, and run dbt commands for testing and documentation.
Familiarity with data modeling concepts: star schemas, fact/dimension tables, and how they translate into efficient dashboard data sources.
Basic Python skills for data wrangling, automation, or extending analytics workflows (pandas, notebooks).

Support Data Modeling: Collaborate with data engineers to define reporting requirements and contribute to dbt model development — building or modifying staging and mart models that feed dashboards and reports. 
Analytical Mindset: Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot data inconsistencies, ask the right questions, and deliver accurate, trustworthy reporting. 
Documentation & Training: Document data definitions, metric calculations, and dashboard usage guides. Provide training and support to business users to promote self-service analytics adoption. 


Expectation from the Candidate:


Experience: 2+ years of experience in a data analyst, BI analyst, or reporting analyst role with a portfolio of dashboards and reports delivered to business stakeholders. 
Technical Prowess: o Strong proficiency in Tableau and/or Power BI: calculated fields, LOD expressions (Tableau), DAX measures (Power BI), parameters, dynamic filters, row-level security, and performance optimization. 
Working knowledge of SQL for querying Snowflake: JOINs, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and basic data transformation. 
Foundational understanding of dbt: ability to read and modify existing models, understand the staging/mart layer structure, and run dbt commands for testing and documentation. 
Familiarity with data modeling concepts: star schemas, fact/dimension tables, and how they translate into efficient dashboard data sources. 
Basic Python skills for data wrangling, automation, or extending analytics workflows (pandas, notebooks). 


Qualifications

Must have skills: Power BI (Strong), Tableau (Strong)

Good to have skills: Data Modeling (Capable), Python (Capable), SQL (Capable)

WHO IS INVENCO By GVR

Invenco by GVR is a dynamic and innovative force in the technology-driven retail solutions. Born from integrating groups within the Gilbarco Veeder-Root network and the strategic acquisition of technology companies worldwide, our foundation is built on tech expertise. With a diverse set of industry leaders including Orpak, Invenco, Insite360 & GVR, we have formed a network of excellence. Our team members are located in over 20 countries and we are proud of the global diversity of our teams.

Who Is Vontier

Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company powering the way the world moves. We empower businesses in the transport sector to adapt to a fast-changing landscape by uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies.

As a Customer Success Manager – Enterprise at Simetrik, you will own value realization across a portfolio of enterprise customers. You are responsible for ensuring that customers consistently use the platform, achieve measurable outcomes, and expand adoption through structured engagement, data-backed conversations, and strong stakeholder management. This is a customer-facing, outcomes-driven role where success is defined by the consistency and quality of your execution: staying close to your accounts, uncovering expansion opportunities, surfacing risk early, and translating product usage into ROI narratives that resonate with senior stakeholders.

A Successful Enterprise CSM At Simetrik

This role directly impacts Simetrik’s Net Revenue Retention and expansion growth strategy. As the CSM for enterprise accounts, you own the performance and commercial durability of a portfolio of strategic customers. You drive adoption, demonstrate measurable ROI, and surface risk early to ensure renewal predictability and expansion readiness. You collaborate closely with Product, Revenue, and Operations, aligning internal teams to deliver outcomes that nurture long-term partnerships and directly influence revenue stability and growth.

First 30–60 Days


Complete onboarding and demonstrate strong product fluency by leading customer conversations focused on business outcomes.
Establish structured portfolio governance for assigned accounts; define meeting cadence, map stakeholders, document success plans.
Achieve consistent and trackable portfolio coverage, ensuring active customer engagement each month.

Build a visible and qualified expansion pipeline by identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities with business cases.
Proactively surface commercial/adoption risk via health indicators and usage data; implement mitigation plans before renewal.

Demonstrate measurable improvements in adoption and usability metrics tied to business outcomes.

About the job

Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Role

Fable Core is the backend, infrastructure, and platform team behind Fable – a social reading product now part of Scribd, Inc. Fable is a leading platform for everything related to books and reading: find your next book, join a book club, build a reading habit. We care deeply about building a great experience for our growing community of 1M+ monthly active users. The Fable app has often been featured in the App Store, both as App Of The Day and the Essential Book Apps list.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Fable Core team, you will set technical direction for the Fable backend and own the reliability and health of the platform that powers the product. You will partner with product, design, ML, and infrastructure partners to turn ambiguous product intent into durable backend systems, lead incident response end-to-end, and raise the ceiling for the team through design leadership and mentorship. We are a small team with broad scope - every position on the team is high-impact.

Our stack: Python/Django, Postgres, Kubernetes, Datadog, GCP / AWS.

What You’ll Do


Set technical direction for the Fable backend – write and socialize technical design documents, drive architecture reviews, and turn ambiguous product intent into concrete backend design.
Own backend reliability and platform health, including staging, CI/CD, databases, queues, cost, and observability.
Lead incident response and drive durable postmortems – write the doc, run the meeting, and make sure action items actually ship.
Be the Fable backend voice in cross-team planning and the glue in cross-functional execution.
Raise the ceiling for the team through PR review, mentorship, pairing, and by setting a high bar on design, testing, and ops.
Build and evolve the Fable backend platform so the team can ship faster and more safely.
Bring agentic engineering practices into the team’s day-to-day work and help the team adopt them effectively.


We’re Looking for Someone With


10+ years of backend experience, including meaningful time in Python/Django and at least one other stack (Go, Node, Java/Kotlin, or similar).
Experience operating production systems on a major cloud – OLTP databases at scale, container orchestration, queueing, and CI/CD.
A track record of owning incidents end-to-end, including the follow-through.
The ability to write a Technical Design Document (TDD) that a staff peer trusts and a product lead can understand, and to turn ambiguous product intent into concrete backend design.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills – you hold your own with senior PM, design, and ML partners, and you care more about the system landing than about being right.
A pragmatic default paired with a strong systems instinct – you look for root causes, not symptoms.
Hands-on experience with agentic engineering tools and workflows in a real production setting.


Nice to Have


Experience with subscription and entitlements systems (Stripe, RevenueCat, App Store / Play billing).
Experience leading a platform or infra function through a migration (on-prem→cloud, AWS↔GCP, monolith→services, or similar).
Experience working alongside ML teams on recommendation or feed systems.

Our Team. Our Passion. Our Approach. 

Position Summary

The Incident Manager is responsible for leading the real-time response to high-impact incidents across complex automated warehouse environments. This role ensures rapid service restoration by coordinating internal engineering teams, customer operations, third-party vendors, and executive stakeholders during Priority 1 and major Priority 2 incidents.

The successful candidate brings a calm, authoritative presence under pressure, technical fluency in automation and IT/OT systems, and excels at structured communication during chaotic scenarios.

Major Incident Response

Track investigation and restoration efforts; ensure all workstreams are aligned.

Root Cause & Continuous Improvement


Initiate and facilitate Post-Incident Reviews

Recommend improvements to automation monitoring, alerting, and recovery playbooks.


Process Ownership & Governance


Ensure adherence to Incident Management policy and escalation matrix.
Own and report on key incident metrics — including mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to resolution (MTTR), and SLA compliance — with regular reporting to leadership.
Drive process development and optimization initiatives to reduce incident frequency, severity, and customer impact.
Maintain and train on major incident playbooks, runbooks, and response templates.



Required Qualifications


5+ years of experience in incident or service management within automated, technical, or industrial environments.
Demonstrated experience managing high-severity incidents (preferably in OT/IT or warehouse automation).
Strong knowledge of one or more of the following: PLCs, SCADA, WES/WMS, controls systems, industrial networks.

Work Environment

description:
About the job

Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Package Specialist-SAP SCM, you will design, implement, and maintain SAP Supply Chain Management (SCM) solutions to optimize supply chain operations across industries. You will work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and ensure seamless integration with existing SAP systems and third-party systems.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include


 Design and Implement Solutions: Design, develop, test, and implement SAP-based supply chain solutions, focusing on successful project delivery and effective integration with clients' existing systems.
 Configure and Customize Modules: Configure and customize SAP SCM modules for processes like warehouse management, global trade, product development, maintenance, quality control, and supply chain collaboration.
 Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and ensure seamless integration with existing SAP systems and third-party systems.
 Troubleshoot Technical Issues: Troubleshoot technical issues and ensure data integrity, accuracy, and security in SAP systems.
 Stay Updated with New Features: Stay updated with new features and functionalities in SAP SCM modules, demonstrating strong technical and analytical skills.


Required Technical And Professional Expertise

We are looking for an SAP Ariba Procure to Pay SME to provide functional support for the end-to-end SAP Ariba and Procure to Pay processes.

In this role, you will troubleshoot incidents, identify root causes, support integrations, and work closely with technical and business teams to ensure the smooth operation of SAP Ariba.

What will you do?

Provide functional support for SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing, including Invoice Management, Catalogs, APC, and master data integrations.

Analyze and resolve Ariba incidents, identifying root causes and providing short- and long-term solutions within the required SLA.

Monitor and troubleshoot Ariba interfaces and integrations between Ariba Network, Invoice Management, CIG, and SAP.

Work with technical teams to analyze integration issues involving ABAP and CPI (Middleware).

Perform ticket triage, identifying whether issues are related to user errors, master data, training needs, system defects, or dependencies with other teams.

Collaborate with IT, Operations, Supply Chain, and business teams to resolve issues and prevent recurring incidents.

Support SAP releases, HRSP updates, instance refreshes, and regression testing.

Design and execute UT, SIT, and UAT test cases, including positive and negative scenarios.

Prepare functional specifications for technical teams developing custom integrations and define the necessary test cases.

Identify opportunities to improve solutions and make the support process more efficient.

Required Skills

Strong experience with SAP Ariba and Procure to Pay (P2P) processes.

Hands-on experience with Ariba Buying and Invoicing.

Experience with Ariba Invoice Management, Catalogs, APC, and master data integrations.

Experience troubleshooting SAP Ariba integrations and interfaces.

Knowledge of CIG (Cloud Integration Gateway) and/or CPI (Cloud Platform Integration).

Experience with incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.

Ability to work effectively with both functional and technical teams.

Experience creating functional specifications and test cases.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience


 Advanced SAP SCM Knowledge: Exposure to advanced features and functionalities in SAP SCM modules, including EWM, GTS, PLM, PM, QM, and SNC, with the ability to apply this knowledge to design and implement complex supply chain solutions.
 Cross-Industry Expertise: Experience working with diverse industries, understanding their unique supply chain challenges, and developing tailored SAP SCM solutions to address these needs.
 Emerging Technology Awareness: Familiarity with emerging technologies and trends in supply chain management, such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, and the Internet of Things (IoT), with the ability to assess their potential impact on SAP SCM solutions.

title: Queue Specialist
skills: Queue Performance & Operational Coverage
Monitor ticket queue performance throughout the day and identify emerging service-level, capacity, and coverage risks.
Coordinate with support leaders and technical teams to rebalance workload, adjust routing, and address volume spikes, absences, and major incidents.
Track staffing coverage and agent availability against demand and promptly communicate gaps or schedule risks to the appropriate leaders.
Maintain queue operating procedures, prioritization rules, routing standards, escalation paths, and customer communication requirements.
Drive follow-up on unassigned, aging, stalled, or at-risk work until ownership and next actions are confirmed.
Provide real-time operational guidance and recommendations without direct supervisory or performance-management responsibility.
Ticket Queue Management & Case Progression
Maintain operational visibility into ticket volume, unassigned work, backlog, aging, severity mix, assignment status, SLA performance, and customer update compliance.
Prioritize P1/P2 incidents, aging P3/P4 tickets, stalled cases, repeat contacts, reopened tickets, and work at risk of breaching service commitments.
Coordinate ticket assignment and rebalancing based on priority, skill, workload, geography, customer impact, and coverage.
Review tickets for complete issue details, business impact, troubleshooting history, evidence, ownership, status, and next-update commitments.
Conduct daily queue reviews and coordinate corrective action when progress, documentation, ownership, or customer communication does not meet standards.
Identify and help resolve assignment gaps, duplicate tickets, routing errors, workflow failures, and other barriers to timely case progression.
Escalation, Communication & Operational Coordination
Serve as the operational coordination point for queue risk, ownership gaps, priority questions, and cross-functional follow-up.
Ensure urgent and high-impact issues are escalated promptly to Incident Management, Technical Support, subject matter experts, or leadership using defined criteria.
Apply warm-handoff standards covering priority, impact, symptoms, timeline, diagnostics, evidence, current status, customer expectations, and next action.
Provide concise operational reporting on ticket backlog, SLA risk, coverage, escalations, and major service events.
Monitor customer update commitments and coordinate follow-up when communications are overdue or incomplete.
Represent queue operations in service reviews, post-incident reviews, and improvement initiatives as requested.
Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
Monitor compliance with ticket workflows, SLAs, escalation requirements, documentation standards, and audit expectations.

description:
About the job

FORTNA partners with the world’s leading brands to transform omnichannel and parcel distribution operations. Known world-wide for enabling companies to keep pace with digital disruption and growth objectives, we design and deliver solutions, powered by intelligent software, to optimize fast, accurate and cost-effective order fulfillment and last mile delivery. Our people, innovative approach and proprietary algorithms and tools ensure optimal operations design and material and information flow. We deliver exceptional value every day to our customers with comprehensive services and products including network strategy, distribution center operational design and implementation, material handling automated equipment, robotics and a comprehensive suite of lifecycle services.

At FORTNA, we believe in fostering a workplace that isn't just a job but a movement – a collective effort to redefine success and transform challenges into opportunities. "Join the Movement" encapsulates our commitment to a workplace culture that thrives on collaboration, celebrates diversity, and empowers every individual to contribute to something greater than themselves. Our Team. Our Passion. Our Approach. 

Position Summary

The Queue Specialist is an individual contributor responsible for the day-to-day performance of the support ticket queue within the Customer Service organization. The role maintains visibility into queue health, service-level performance, workload distribution, case quality, and timely routing and escalation across all priorities.

The Queue Specialst monitors real-time and interval ticket performance, coordinates workload adjustments with support leaders and technical teams, and drives follow-up when ticket service levels are at risk. The role partners with Incident Management, Technical Support, subject matter experts, and leadership to improve routing, accelerate ticket progression, and prevent backlogs from stagnating.

This position has no direct reports. Success depends on strong operational judgment, data analysis, clear communication, and the ability to influence timely action across teams without formal people-management authority.

Key Responsibilities


 Queue Performance & Operational Coverage
Monitor ticket queue performance throughout the day and identify emerging service-level, capacity, and coverage risks. 
Coordinate with support leaders and technical teams to rebalance workload, adjust routing, and address volume spikes, absences, and major incidents. 
Track staffing coverage and agent availability against demand and promptly communicate gaps or schedule risks to the appropriate leaders. 
Maintain queue operating procedures, prioritization rules, routing standards, escalation paths, and customer communication requirements. 
Drive follow-up on unassigned, aging, stalled, or at-risk work until ownership and next actions are confirmed. 
Provide real-time operational guidance and recommendations without direct supervisory or performance-management responsibility. 
 Ticket Queue Management & Case Progression 
Maintain operational visibility into ticket volume, unassigned work, backlog, aging, severity mix, assignment status, SLA performance, and customer update compliance. 
Prioritize P1/P2 incidents, aging P3/P4 tickets, stalled cases, repeat contacts, reopened tickets, and work at risk of breaching service commitments. 
Coordinate ticket assignment and rebalancing based on priority, skill, workload, geography, customer impact, and coverage. 
Review tickets for complete issue details, business impact, troubleshooting history, evidence, ownership, status, and next-update commitments. 
Conduct daily queue reviews and coordinate corrective action when progress, documentation, ownership, or customer communication does not meet standards. 
Identify and help resolve assignment gaps, duplicate tickets, routing errors, workflow failures, and other barriers to timely case progression. 
 Escalation, Communication & Operational Coordination 
Serve as the operational coordination point for queue risk, ownership gaps, priority questions, and cross-functional follow-up. 
Ensure urgent and high-impact issues are escalated promptly to Incident Management, Technical Support, subject matter experts, or leadership using defined criteria. 
Apply warm-handoff standards covering priority, impact, symptoms, timeline, diagnostics, evidence, current status, customer expectations, and next action. 
Provide concise operational reporting on ticket backlog, SLA risk, coverage, escalations, and major service events. 
Monitor customer update commitments and coordinate follow-up when communications are overdue or incomplete. 
Represent queue operations in service reviews, post-incident reviews, and improvement initiatives as requested. 
 Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement 
Monitor compliance with ticket workflows, SLAs, escalation requirements, documentation standards, and audit expectations. 
Track and report measures such as first-contact resolution, ticket response time, backlog aging, reopen rate, update compliance, quality scores, and customer satisfaction. 
Analyze demand trends, repeat contacts, misrouted tickets, escalation delays, knowledge gaps, and capacity constraints to identify improvement opportunities. 
Maintain queue dashboards, operating procedures, routing guidance, and reporting materials. 
Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with process owners, technical teams, and stakeholders and track improvements through measurable outcomes. 
Recommend tools, automation, routing, workflow, self-service, and coverage improvements that increase responsiveness and customer experience. 



Required Qualifications


7+ years of service desk, technical support, call center, or ticket operations experience. 
Demonstrated experience monitoring or coordinating high-volume ticket queues in a 24x7 or extended-hours support environment. 
Experience with real-time queue monitoring, workload balancing, ticket assignment, SLA tracking, and escalation coordination. 
Strong knowledge of incident prioritization, ticket lifecycle management, routing, documentation, escalation, and customer communication. 
Ability to interpret ticket and operational metrics, identify trends and service risks, and recommend corrective actions. 
Experience using case-management, reporting, and knowledge-management platforms. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence action across technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Sound judgment under pressure and the ability to make timely operational decisions during high-volume periods and critical incidents. 
Strong organizational, analytical, conflict-resolution, and problem-solving skills. 
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment. 
Ability to support nights, weekends, holidays, and non-traditional schedules as operational needs require. 



Preferred Qualifications


3+ years leading technical support teams or queue management. 
Bachelor's degree in information technology, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
ITIL, HDI, contact-center, or workforce-management certification. 
Experience with enterprise telephony, automatic call distribution, or workforce-management platforms. 
Experience supporting business-critical, technical, or industrial environments. 
Experience improving queue performance through workflow automation, skill-based routing, self-service, analytics, or knowledge-centered support practices.

It's more than a job

In an administrative role at Kuehne+Nagel, tasks such as managing office operations or coordinating schedules certainly contribute to your team's success, but they also provide meaningful moments for people around the world. Because your attention to detail supports your colleagues to perform at their best, such as ensuring the timely and seamless transport of hearing aids and advanced medical devices that change lives. Join Kuehne+Nagel's Project Logistics team and play a key role in delivering complex and specialized logistics solutions. Execute and monitor assigned project shipments, ensuring timely and accurate operational delivery.

Collaborate with regional and global Project Logistics stakeholders across the Kuehne+Nagel network.

Develop expertise in complex logistics project execution, operational planning, and financial management.

Who are we

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

At Near, we connect top talent in Latin America with exciting remote opportunities at U.S.-based companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders.

About the Company

Our client is an AI-powered personal growth and mentoring company focused on helping people make better decisions, gain clarity, and create meaningful change. Unlike traditional AI coaching apps, our client combines structured coaching frameworks, psychometric assessments, and behavior-change science to drive measurable progress rather than simply providing conversational support. Since launching in Q4 2025, the company has grown rapidly to tens of thousands of users globally.

About the Role

We're looking for a Customer Support & Operations Coordinator to own our customer-facing experience end to end. People come to our client’s app when they're trying to change something real, and when they write to us they're usually in the middle of it. Our job is to meet them there. Support here is human, grounded, and realistic.

This is an execution role: you're in the ticket queue, talking to real people, learning the product and our voice. As you get settled and show you can operate at a high level, you'll take on more surfaces, more independence, and eventually a real hand in how this function gets built. You'll thrive here if you genuinely enjoy talking to customers, take pride in doing it well, and are curious about the operations work behind the scenes.

You should also expect to flex. We're a small team, and some weeks you'll pick up projects outside the support queue — reporting, data cleanup, campaign QA, process work. That's one of the better parts of this role: it's real exposure to how operations run at a growing company, and it builds a broader ops skill set that's hard to get this early in a career.

Own the support queue. Resolve inbound tickets in Zendesk on account access, subscriptions, billing, and product questions — accurately, in our voice, same-day.

No degree required. We care what you can do, not where you studied.
Demonstrated experience handling meaningful ticket volume — you can tell us your numbers
Proficiency with a helpdesk platform (Zendesk preferred; Intercom, Front, or Help Scout translate fine)
Comfort with subscription billing mechanics — App Store, Google Play, and Stripe: refunds, chargebacks, plan changes, failed payments
Community platform experience, ideally Discord (roles, moderation, channel management)
Working comfort with spreadsheets, dashboards, and basic reporting
Fluent with AI tools as an accelerant — we expect you to use them well and know when not to

Soft skills

Exceptional written English. You can be warm, clear, and brief in the same four-sentence reply, and you write the way people actually talk. This is the single most important qualification for this role.
Judgment in gray areas. Refunds, exceptions, edge cases. You can hold a boundary kindly and know when to bend one.

Just imagine Amazon customers across Mexico and Brazil finding the right products at the right time, even during peak demand. You'll be the link between insight and action!

As our Customer Planning Manager, you'll help shape sustainable, profitable growth across Amazon Mexico and Brazil by turning demand signals into action. You'll forecast demand, manage inventory, and optimize operations to support customer satisfaction while balancing commercial ambition with supply chain execution. Working closely with account managers and cross-functional partners, you'll spot risks early, influence decisions with data, and help strengthen the LEGO® business across two growing markets.

Success means creating dependable plans that help the business grow while keeping inventory healthy and customers supplied.
