At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.


Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action.

Knowledge about the industry we exist in and the clients we serve.

You have familiarity with Power BI, SQL, or BI/reporting workflows.

What We Offer

At GrowthAssistant, you aren’t just joining a company; you’re joining a movement to redefine how the world’s best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything — and that starts with how we take care of you.




We support your life inside and outside of work with a comprehensive benefits package:

Fully Remote: 100% Remote work environment, never fight traffic again
Health Coverage: HMO or Healthcare Stipend (depending on location) after 90 days of service
Time to Recharge: 7 Paid Holidays and up to 6 PTO days per year
Family First: Parental leave after 1 year of service




We offer additional incentives for go-getters and proven performers!

$25 monthly perfect attendance bonus
Performance bonus
Anniversary bonus ($100 at 1 year; $200 at 2 years)
Earn a $300 referral bonus for each candidate you refer who is successfully hired, and $500 when you help us identify and close a new opportunity with your client




Your Application Roadmap

You’ve applied, now let’s get to work. Here’s the play-by-play:

Step 1 Resume Screening: Our hiring team reviews your experience to see how your unique skills align with our high-growth roles.
Step 2 Recruiter Interview: If we believe we have a great client match, we’ll reach out to schedule a human-to-human chat to discuss your career goals, experience, and what makes you tick.
Step 3 Online Assessment: This is your chance to shine! You’ll complete a role-specific test, a personality assessment, and your official GA Profile Form so we can represent you.
Step 4 Match Interview: You’ll meet with one of our Senior Leaders for a deep-dive validation to ensure we’re matching you with the right opportunity. This is your moment to bring your A-game and really shine — it’s the final step for many of our roles!




Depending on the client, there are sometimes 2 additional steps:

Step 5 15-min Prep Call: We’ve got your back. Before the final round, your Recruiter will hop on a quick call to coach you, share insider tips, and ensure you’re 100% ready.
Step 6 Client Interview: You’ll meet the client to discuss how you’ll help them scale and succeed. Bring your metrics and be on your A-game — this is your last chance to make a great first impression!




Join our 100% remote global team today, and grow with GrowthAssistant!




GrowthAssistant is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Paystand is the world's leading blockchain-enabled B2B payments network, transforming commercial finance into a software-driven, zero-fee, and open ecosystem. Recognized as a CNBC/Statista 2026 World's Top Fintech company, Paystand delivers over a decade of on-chain payments experience to middle and large enterprises.

Paystand's network services more than one million payors that have moved $20+ billion in volume. With its acquisitions of Yaydoo, Teampay and Bitwage, Paystand's full-stack platform includes agentic AI, its USDb stablecoin, and AR/AP solutions on one tightly integrated network. Its non-profit arm, Paystand.org, advances the mission to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain technology.

What We Do

We built the financial system we always thought should exist: zero fees, zero friction, just your money, faster. Blockchain automates receivables and payables, cuts time-to-cash, and turns every transaction into revenue instead of cost.

The current system takes a cut from the people who build, create, and grow — and calls it the cost of doing business. We don't buy that. Every fee we eliminate compounds into growth. We don't wait for permission or for the industry to catch up — we build the future of finance ourselves, on-chain, in the open. Small moves now, monumental results later.

Architecture and Engineering:
Strong understanding of modern application architecture, including modular system design, API design, asynchronous and event-driven processing, data consistency, caching, and integration patterns.
Demonstrated ability to design systems that can evolve and scale without introducing unnecessary complexity.
Experience making and documenting architectural decisions based on reliability, security, performance, cost, maintainability, and speed of delivery.
Practical experience with relational databases, data modeling, distributed systems, observability, automated testing, and production troubleshooting.
Familiarity with secure engineering practices appropriate for financial or other high-trust systems, including authorization, data protection, auditability, failure recovery, and idempotent processing.
Full-Stack Product Development:
Strong experience with at least one modern frontend ecosystem, such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Angular, including component architecture, state management, accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
Strong experience with at least one production backend ecosystem, such as Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, Elixir, or a comparable framework.
Ability to design clear APIs and data contracts and integrate with internal services, third-party platforms, and legacy systems.
Product-minded approach to frontend development, with attention to workflows, usability, edge cases, and the complete customer experience—not simply implementation from a design file.

Cloud, Scaling, and Delivery:
Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating production systems on AWS or Google Cloud.
Working knowledge of Cloudflare capabilities such as DNS, CDN, edge security, traffic management, Workers, or related edge infrastructure.
Experience with containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, environment management, secrets management, and automated deployment practices.
Understanding of horizontal scaling, load management, queues, caching, database scaling, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and multi-region considerations.
Ability to build useful observability into a product through logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and business-level workflow monitoring.
Comfortable owning software after release, including production health, incident response, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
Product Ownership and Leadership:
Product mindset with the ability to co-own a product area alongside a product manager, from customer problem and business outcome through technical delivery and adoption.
Able to challenge assumptions, identify simpler solutions, define incremental releases, and balance immediate customer value with long-term technical health.
Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to engineering, product, design, operations, and business stakeholders.
Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture, execution, code review, mentorship, and raising engineering standards.
High degree of ownership, curiosity, pragmatism, and follow-through.

Experience with high-integrity workflows involving money movement, reconciliation, ledgers, approvals, or external financial integrations.

Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. title: Business Development Representative
description:
About the job

Powering the world’s payments ecosystem




ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.




Job Purpose




The Business Development Representative (BDR), LATAM is responsible for driving pipeline development and supporting new business growth across Latin America. Based in Mexico and working remotely, this role works in close alignment with the regional Sales organization while reporting into the Marketing team and partnering closely with the LATAM Marketing Manager.

The BDR serves as a critical link between Marketing and Sales by evaluating inbound leads, identifying and qualifying prospective opportunities, executing outbound prospecting campaigns, and scheduling meetings that create qualified sales conversations. Success in this role is measured by the ability to generate and qualify pipeline, accelerate lead progression, improve conversion rates, and create meaningful engagement opportunities for ACI's New Business sales teams.




Essential Functions and Responsibilities




- Partner closely with LATAM sales leaders, LATAM Marketing Manager and regional New Business sales teams to support pipeline generation and revenue growth.

- Evaluate inbound leads and inquiries to determine qualification, business fit, buying intent, and readiness for sales engagement.

- Conduct outreach to prospective customers through phone, email, social media, and other channels to generate qualified meetings and opportunities.

- Execute targeted outbound prospecting campaigns aligned with regional sales priorities and account-based marketing initiatives.

- Leverage AI-powered sales, research, and productivity tools to scale prospecting activities, identify buying signals, prioritize opportunities, personalize outreach, automate administrative tasks, and increase the effectiveness of pipeline generation efforts while adhering to ACI security, privacy, and governance standards.

- Schedule and coordinate meetings between qualified prospects and sales representatives.

- Build and manage prospect lists in collaboration with regional sales and marketing teams.

- Support lead nurturing activities and ensure timely follow-up on marketing-generated leads.

- Maintain accurate lead, contact, activity, and opportunity records within Salesforce and other sales and marketing platforms.

- Monitor lead progression and work closely with sales teams to improve conversion rates and pipeline velocity.

- Provide feedback to Marketing regarding campaign effectiveness, lead quality, messaging, and market trends.

- Track and report on key business development metrics, including outreach activity, meetings generated, qualified opportunities, and pipeline contribution.

- Perform other duties as assigned.

- Understand and adhere to all Corporate Policies, including but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.




Qualifications (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)




- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent professional experience.

- 2-5 years of experience in business development, sales development, lead generation, inside sales, or related B2B sales roles.

- Proven experience generating and qualifying sales opportunities.

- Experience supporting enterprise sales organizations.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Results-oriented mindset with demonstrated ability to achieve activity and pipeline goals.




Preferred Qualifications (Education, Experience, Competencies)




- Experience within payments, banking, fintech, software, SaaS, or technology industries.

- Experience supporting Latin American markets.

- Knowledge of Salesforce CRM.

- Experience using HubSpot, Demandbase, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar prospecting and marketing technologies.

- Familiarity with Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs.

- Experience using AI-powered sales and business development platforms to enhance prospecting, account research, customer engagement, and pipeline development.

- Remote/telecommuter position based in Mexico.

- Regular collaboration with sales and marketing teams across Latin America and North America.

- Travel may be required for sales meetings, events, and internal planning sessions (up to 15%).




Success Measures

- Qualified meetings generated.

- Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) created.

- Lead response and qualification effectiveness.

- CRM data quality and activity tracking.

- Sales stakeholder satisfaction and alignment.




ACI Worldwide is an Equal Opportunity Employer.




Important Notice About Recruitment Scams




Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company (www.aciworldwide.com / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.

title: Client Solutions Strategist, Ad-Sales - Mexico
description:

Responsibilities
The Client Solutions team is responsible for leading the development of TikTok’s commercial and solutions strategy in the Mexico region, ensuring alignment with global directives while adapting them to the specific needs and dynamics of markets.

Our team focuses on delivering customized 1:1 solutions for clients, working both reactively, when responding to specific client briefings, and proactively, by identifying business opportunities in collaboration with the Sales team.
We are responsible for overseeing and managing the development of the Levers Strategy, including its goals, targets, and product focus areas, fully aligned with the team's global direction and adapted to regional needs.

We operate in close partnership with the Industry Ops LATAM team and collaborate with cross-functional teams such as GBM and GMPT, with a shared focus on building strong governance and scalable best practices across the Global Business Solutions (GBS) organization.

You will act as the team’s domain specialist to remove execution bottlenecks, accelerate adoption of advanced advertising and measurement solutions, and elevate technical and strategic depth across Client Solutions. The role bridges Sales, CS Leads, CSMs, Product, Measurement, and Engineering teams to scale complex solutions across priority verticals and accounts.

- Own subject matter expertise across strategic solution domains (Levers) such as Apps, Measurement, Signals, SKAN, Leads, Branding, TTS, Catalog, or Commerce solutions.

About the job

About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About The Team

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

Role Summary

Fanatics Collect is building a trusted marketplace where collectors can securely store, discover, buy, and sell trading cards. We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to develop the customer experiences and platform capabilities that power the Collect marketplace, including Vault, Buy Now, auctions, and the tooling used to manage marketplace operations.

In this role, you will own complex features across the technology stack, from intuitive web experiences to scalable services and data models. You will partner with product, design, operations, and engineering teams to deliver reliable marketplace experiences that make collecting easier, faster, and more engaging.

As part of Fanatics Collectibles’ continued global growth, we are establishing a new technology hub in Mexico City focused on operational excellence, platform scalability, trust, and customer experience. This team partners closely with Customer Experience (CX), Trust & Safety, Fraud Prevention, Payments, and Financial Operations organizations to build scalable systems and operational tooling that support millions of users and transactions globally.

What You’ll Do


Design, build, test, deploy, and operate full-stack features supporting Vault, Buy Now, auctions, and marketplace tooling.
Develop intuitive customer experiences for managing vaulted assets, creating listings, placing bids, purchasing collectibles, and tracking transactions.
Build scalable backend services and APIs that support marketplace workflows, inventory, listings, bidding, and order lifecycles.
Strengthen the reliability and integrity of time-sensitive and transaction-heavy experiences, including live auctions and high-demand product activity.
Translate complex marketplace and operational requirements into maintainable technical solutions.
Partner with product managers and designers to shape requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and deliver high-quality customer experiences.
Collaborate with platform, infrastructure, data, security, and other engineering teams to build integrated solutions across the Collect ecosystem.
Improve application performance, observability, testing, deployment practices, and production readiness.
Diagnose complex production issues, contribute to incident response, and drive root-cause fixes.
Establish reusable patterns and engineering practices that improve the quality and velocity of full-stack development.
Provide thoughtful code reviews, technical guidance, and mentorship to other engineers.
Contribute to architectural decisions and help evolve the marketplace technology roadmap.


What We’re Looking For


Five or more years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful ownership of full-stack applications.
Strong experience building modern web applications using technologies such as React, TypeScript, or comparable frameworks and languages.
Experience developing backend services and APIs using languages and frameworks such as Node.js, Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, or similar technologies.
Strong understanding of data modeling and experience working with relational or non-relational databases.
Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, customer-facing systems in a production environment.
Understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, caching, and event-driven architecture.
Experience with automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, observability, and cloud-based deployment.
Ability to break down ambiguous problems, make sound technical decisions, and deliver solutions across multiple systems.
Strong product judgment and an appreciation for how technical decisions affect customers and business operations.
Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, design, and operational teams.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience building e-commerce, marketplace, fintech, auction, inventory, or other transaction-oriented products.
Experience developing real-time or time-sensitive functionality, such as bidding, pricing, notifications, or live-event experiences.
Familiarity with payments, order management, fulfillment, identity, fraud prevention, or marketplace trust and safety.
Experience supporting internal operational tools alongside external customer experiences.
Interest in trading cards, collectibles, marketplaces, or collector communities.


How You’ll Make An Impact

You will help shape the technology that connects physical collectibles with digital marketplace experiences. Your work will enable collectors to confidently manage vaulted assets, participate in auctions, purchase cards, and engage with the Collect marketplace at scale.

title: Regulatory Solutions Analyst (Judicial Orders) - México
skills: SITI AA Management: Daily monitoring, control, and end-to-end execution of digital requirements received through CNBV’s SITI AA portal (Atención a Autoridades), ensuring zero regulatory gaps or SLA breaches.

Authority Enquiries & Judicial Orders: Analyzing, processing, and responding to official subpoenas, information requests, and documentation requirements from CNBV, SAT, FGR, and competent judicial/administrative authorities.
Account Asset Orders: Executing regulatory actions regarding account freezing (aseguramiento), unfreezing (desbloqueo), and asset transfers in accordance with Mexican banking laws and CNBV mandates.

Blocked Person List (LPB): Actively supporting operational routines and monitoring workflows related to Mexico’s Lista de Personas Bloqueadas (LPB), ensuring immediate compliance upon update releases.

Regulatory Governance & SLA Control: Managing operational queues, tracking SLAs, and updating BI dashboards (Looker/Sheets) to guarantee timely execution and full auditability of all authority requests.

Continuous Process Improvement: Partnering with Legal, Compliance, and Tech teams to automate SITI AA routines, refine operational controls, and adapt workflows to regulatory updates (CNBV / SOFIPO framework).
Audit & Archiving Readiness: Documenting decisions, responses, and execution proofs to maintain traceable audit trails for regulatory inspections and internal reviews.
Direct Experience with SITI AA: Proven hands-on experience managing and executing requirements via CNBV’s SITI AA system in the Mexican financial sector (Banking, SOFIPOs, or Fintechs).
Regulatory Knowledge: Solid understanding of financial secrecy laws (secreto bancario/financiero), CNBV regulations, and legal procedures for judicial orders and account freezing/unfreezing.
Analytical & Detail-Oriented Mindset: Exceptional precision in handling sensitive customer data, legal documents, and official authority templates under tight, non-negotiable regulatory deadlines.
Process Discipline: Comfort with high-volume operational workflows, maintaining high accuracy and compliance even within bureaucratic and structured regulatory frameworks.
Data & BI Literacy: Familiarity with queue management and data visualization tools (Excel, Google Sheets, Looker) to monitor performance and tracking metrics.
Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills in Spanish (required for official authority responses) and English/Portuguese (for internal stakeholders).
Degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or related fields.
Prior experience in Compliance, AML/PLD, or Regulatory Legal Operations within a regulated financial institution.
Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, or database querying to optimize reporting and operational audits.
Familiarity with broader AML frameworks, customer onboarding restrictions, and CNBV audit procedures.

Ensure Nubank’s sustainable growth by maintaining rigorous compliance with financial secrecy regulations and authority requirements in Mexico. What We’re Looking For


Direct Experience with SITI AA: Proven hands-on experience managing and executing requirements via CNBV’s SITI AA system in the Mexican financial sector (Banking, SOFIPOs, or Fintechs).

Nice to Have


Degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or related fields.
Prior experience in Compliance, AML/PLD, or Regulatory Legal Operations within a regulated financial institution.
Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, or database querying to optimize reporting and operational audits.
